note: Private RV park on the west shore of Topaz Lake at the Nevada line. Mostly booked by returning guests: monthly stays in spring and fall, and Saturday-to-Saturday weeks in summer; shorter stays are taken where they fit, and overnighters may drop in. Reserve by text or phone. Sites 15-21 line the lake edge; the drawdown can leave a beach in front. --Claude
summary: Topaz Lake RV Park: $46 spring / $60 summer / $49 fall (price gate passes on shoulder nights), 54 FHU 30 A sites, phone/text only, 1 year ahead; season Mar-Oct (2027 Mar 1 - Oct 10). Google 4.4/168. Long-stay tests pass (no site count), but it runs on returning monthly and weekly guests - caveat in the note. Lakefront KEPT for sites 15-21.
flags: LONG-STAY (reported, not a drop candidate): five tests - (1) $46 shoulder nightly under $50 (summer $60, shoulder nights count) PASS; (2) nightly rate on the operator's own rate sheet + phone, no application/lease/membership PASS; (3) no standing minimum PASS (summer weeks are Saturday-to-Saturday but 'I will take reservations or a wait list for a shorter period than a week'); (4) no nightly site count published (no count = pass); (5) not a home community PASS. But the operator says 'most of the reservations from March until the beginning of the summer season are monthly customers', summer runs on 'a long standing history of each customer coming during their designated weeks', and seasonal stays are wait-listed for 2027. Drop-ins are explicitly welcomed ('Overniters are always welcome to drop in'), so not discouraging wording; note carries the caveat. Reviewer's call if summer week-only reads as 'sold weekly only'.

WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' (not --AWH) KEPT. Sites 15-21 (row ~38.6825,-119.5473 to 38.6820,-119.5469) line the rock-edged lake shore on the operator map; on Esri they sit behind scattered cottonwoods (not continuous canopy), ~20 m to the shore over a gentle beach; 3DEP puts the row at 1525-1527 m against a ~1524 m shore line (lidar water 1522 m, drawn down), so pads ~1-3 m over full pool, and the operator says full pool reaches 'right at the edge of the Park'. Nightly in spring/fall; summer mostly by the week. Site 50 at the SE corner is also by the shore. The inland rows (1-14, 22-49A) are lakeview or less.
